dbl.text: Light-Paws, the emperor's advisor in Eiganjo, told Kaito there would be no more sparring lessons because Eiko had chosen to study as a kami diplomat, and that he must choose a path.

Kaito refused to be a samurai and turned his back on his mentor, and when he told his account of the metal-armed man, Light-Paws suggested the Futurists were responsible and refused to listen, ordering him to his room.
Later she and Eiko bowed to the emperor, who ordered the court to prepare its forces against the Uprisers.
With her spark destabilizing, the emperor named Light-Paws her proxy to rule Kamigawa with Kyodai's blessing, and Light-Paws grew a new tail as Kaito and Eiko bowed to the new Regent of Kamigawa.
